public_payload.normalized_proposition: Every organization the author spoke to has exceeded or nearly exhausted its annual AI token budget five months into 2026.
conditions: organizations the author has talked to

statement.excerpt: Every organization I’ve talked to has exceeded or is nearing the edge of their annual token budget barely five months into the year, which means that everybody has suddenly given themselves an extra few million dollars’ worth of operating expenses for reasons that escape effectively everybody I’ve talked to.

from_speaker: has exceeded or is nearing the edge
barely five months into the year
our_interpretation: The population is the author's interview sample, not all organizations using AI.
The observation covers spending from January 1 through the May 19, 2026 publication date against each organization's full-year 2026 budget.
The ordinary reading of 'nearing the edge' is that little of the annual allocation remains. No precise percentage is supplied, so borderline cases require clarification.
The budget's accounting basis and whether it covers all AI tokens or particular vendors are unspecified.
criteria.support_condition: Identify the complete interview sample and obtain comparable budget and spending records showing that every organization had exceeded or nearly exhausted its relevant annual allocation by May 19, 2026.
criteria.contradiction_condition: Establish that at least one organization in that interview sample still had a substantial portion of its relevant annual allocation remaining on the applicable interview date.
